workflows.trigger: Herdr Android/Termux migration request or readiness evidence
steps: read AGENTS.md, harness doctrine, parent Android harness, Herdr manifest, codebase map and scoped skill
preserve tmux as canonical and product runtime files as read-only
resolve explicit or newest local herdr-readiness and install-review evidence
render Get-HerdrHarnessStatus.py classification
select reviewed-installation, runtime-compatibility-review, failure-recovery, validation, or handoff at the first unproved gate
workflows.proofCeiling: routing from current evidence only; no installation approval or runtime promotion

workflows.trigger: KEEP_TMUX_HERDR_NOT_INSTALLED without a completed source-bound BLOCKED install review
steps: read the tracked upstream installation source snapshot before building the review
refresh that snapshot from current official install docs plus release/tag metadata when stale or when install authority might change
create the source-bound herdr-install-review artifact with Build-HerdrInstallReview.py --write
require BLOCKED when official upstream does not explicitly establish Android/Termux support and emit no install command
reject undocumented cargo install, curl-pipe-shell proof, automatic device_config/battery mutation and tmux removal
route a completed BLOCKED review forward to runtime-compatibility-review rather than rebuilding the same artifact
workflows.proofCeiling: the current source-bound review proves BLOCKED; it does not install Herdr or prove Android compatibility

workflows.trigger: source-bound install review is BLOCKED because Android/Termux support is not established
steps: read upstream-runtime-compatibility.json bound to Herdr v0.8.0 release commit 346411fa21afd297f5ed3b3fa56f9e3fbf7654b7
distinguish the published aarch64-unknown-linux-musl prebuilt from a native aarch64-linux-android source build
keep native Android source build BLOCKED while target_os=android selects Herdr's unsupported fallback platform module
render Build-HerdrCompatibilityReview.py --write
permit only the tracked ephemeral prebuilt identity probe: exact asset, exact byte size, exact SHA-256, isolated --version, bounded timeout, automatic temporary cleanup
do not install, start a server, create/attach a session, mutate Android policy, or remove tmux from this probe
on successful execution identity route to a separate bounded-server-start review; on failure preserve evidence and keep tmux
workflows.proofCeiling: can prove exact source/build assumptions and ephemeral --version execution identity only; not installation or server compatibility

steps: parse wrapper, legacy readiness probe and hooks with bash -n
run migration, source-bound installation-review, compatibility-review and harness completeness tests
run the prebuilt compatibility probe in contract mode only; CI must never download/execute the release asset
run PowerShell completeness where available
run existing Android Termux portable floor
run git diff --check and verify generated evidence remains untracked/outside the repository
workflows.proofCeiling: tracked harness contracts only; not same-device runtime proof

workflows.trigger: probe, validator or migration gate failure
steps: preserve first bounded non-sensitive failure evidence
missing Herdr plus no install review => keep tmux and route to source-bound reviewed-installation
completed blocked install review => route forward to runtime-compatibility-review
native Android source-build request => keep blocked while the pinned source selects unsupported fallback platform behavior
prebuilt identity probe download/digest/exec/timeout failure => keep tmux and preserve herdr-prebuilt-exec evidence without installing
successful prebuilt --version => do not install; route to a separately reviewed bounded-server-start gate
tracked validator failure => repair inside harness scope and rerun the complete focused floor
render operator report with one next command
workflows.proofCeiling: failure boundary and evidence preservation only

workflows.trigger: focused validation completed or a real authority/runtime blocker remains
steps: run Get-HerdrHarnessStatus.py --write with explicit evidence/review when known
record repo/branch/head/PR and validator results separately from phone evidence
state tracked installation and runtime-compatibility source snapshots separately from live proof
state working, broken/blocked, missing/unproved, proof reached and proof ceiling
provide one exact executable next command that advances the first unproved gate
keep credentials, device codes, private evidence and machine-local junk out of Git/PR
workflows.proofCeiling: handoff summarizes evidence; it is not additional installation/runtime/merge/deployment proof
